error.httpUrl: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.httpUrlTemplate: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS URL; it may contain {key}.
error.encryptionMissing: Secret encryption is not configured. Set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY first.
error.credentialsRequired: Enter the full access key for the first configuration.
error.publicBaseUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) URL or a relative path starting with /.
test.failed: The connection test failed. Check the saved configuration and service status.
test.requestFailed: The connection test request failed or timed out. Try again later.
title: Storage
description: Manage where media, brand assets and backups are stored.
backend.label: Storage backend
backend.current: Currently saved: {kind}. Switching only affects new files; existing files stay readable and are not migrated.
backend.envHint: Uses server environment variables such as STORAGE_DRIVER. This plugin does not take over storage; saving this option clears the S3 keys stored by the plugin.
local.title: Local storage
local.rootHint: Leave empty to use `storage` under the data directory. The directory lives on the server running the service.
local.publicBaseUrlHint: Used to build file access URLs.
s3.connectHint: Supports AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and S3-compatible object storage.
s3.endpointHint: Leave empty for AWS S3; other services need their S3 API endpoint.
s3.regionHint: Use the region your provider gave you; R2 usually uses auto.
s3.keysConfigured: Access keys are configured; leave empty to keep them. Keys are never echoed back.
s3.keysNew: Keys are stored encrypted and never returned when reading configuration.
s3.encryptionMissing: Secret storage is not enabled. Set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server and restart the service.
s3.publicBaseUrlHint: A CDN or custom domain; leave empty to derive it from the endpoint and bucket.
http.uploadHint: Files are proxied through the server to the image host; presigned direct upload is not supported.
http.publicBaseUrlHint: A file URL is the read base URL joined with the object key.
http.headersHint: One header per line, formatted as Header: value. These are ordinary configuration, so use credentials with restricted permissions.
http.deleteUrlHint: {key} is substituted with the object key. Leave empty to send DELETE to the file read URL.
save.noPermission: Configuration cannot be saved right now. Check your permissions or sign in again.
test.title: Connection test
test.dirty: There are unsaved changes; save before testing.
test.hint: A passing test only means the current connection works.
page.unavailable: Storage configuration is unavailable right now. Refresh and try again.
